name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 56 – Am 43
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 56a. Calls for full transparency regarding EU, national and third-country funding of civil society organisations, think tanks and umbrella organisations involved in democratic-resilience activities, including amounts, intermediaries, beneficiaries and purposes; stresses that transparency rules must apply equally and proportionately;
